Preserve reference actual silhouette/proportions, shape, regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions weave, cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections finish, colors, count and positions of rods, slots, pockets, channels, tiers, handles, clips, locks, hinges, windows, legs, supports and secondary materials. Reference defines actual visible design, do not redesign it. From rear keep front-facing recesses/handles/features on hidden opposite side, show described back surfaces and braces. From side reveal actual depth. Entire product centered with generous margins, same warm-white seamless backdrop, scale, lighting and shadow; sharp fibers, square. Empty product, no papers/cards/goods, props, people, animals, food, plants, room or detached extra products. No mirroring substitute, montage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, numbers, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, symbols, inscriptions or measurements.
